title: RemotiveTopology workspace marker
description: Marker file (`remotive.yaml`) at a RemotiveTopology workspace root. Generated by `remotive topology workspace init`.

schema.description: URL of the schema this marker conforms to.

name.description: Human-readable workspace name. Defaults to the workspace directory's basename.

requires-version.description: RemotiveCLI versions this workspace works with, written as in Python packaging (PEP 440), e.g. `">=0.40,<1.0"`. Every command using the workspace checks it. Quote values starting with `>` or `<` in YAML. Any version is allowed if not set.
